exam.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Developer
exam.study_prerequisites: Applied Business Central and AL development experience across extension architecture, Visual Studio Code, app configuration/dependencies, tables/pages/reports/XMLports/codeunits/queries/permissions, Business Central data and document patterns, automated testing, telemetry, lifecycle upgrades and secure REST/API integration.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Install, develop, and deploy for Business Central
Integrate Business Central with other applications

review.notes: Every June 10, 2025 subobjective maps to an architecture/app/lifecycle boundary, project/configuration, AL object/procedure/pattern, permission, test, telemetry/performance signal or HTTP/API contract. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 checks cover all six domains. All 18 URLs are cataloged: 17 reachable, with O'Reilly automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records the active 100-minute seven-language exam, free assessment, 50h07 selected official paths, five-day course, MIT labs, live/commercial options and explicit older-blueprint freshness boundaries.

findings.title: Prior snapshot was condensed
findings.evidence: 17 summary rows represent75 detailed objectives on the unchanged June2025 baseline.
findings.recommendation: Preserve previous evidence and restore canonical text.
findings.resolution: Preserve previous evidence and restore canonical text.

findings.title: Caught try errors do not imply rollback
findings.evidence: Writes are not automatically rolled back; consumed-return calls differ.
findings.recommendation: Correct broad rollback prose and add boundary exercise.
findings.resolution: Correct broad rollback prose and add boundary exercise.

findings.title: Boolean Codeunit.Run commits successful work
findings.evidence: Existing transaction and implicit commit behavior change atomicity.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit contract and avoid casual precommit.
findings.resolution: Add explicit contract and avoid casual precommit.

findings.title: Sandbox cannot demonstrate replica lag
findings.evidence: Read scale-out is unavailable in sandboxes; intent does not guarantee routing.
findings.recommendation: Correct lab evidence boundary and explain precedence.
findings.resolution: Correct lab evidence boundary and explain precedence.

findings.title: Transactional batch depends on commit behavior
findings.evidence: Isolation snapshot shares a session; intervening commits split transactions.

findings.title: HTTP controls have advanced since older training
findings.evidence: Certificate validation and anti-SSRF vary by version/deployment.
findings.recommendation: Add supported outbound controls and separate transport/status/payload outcomes.
findings.resolution: Add supported outbound controls and separate transport/status/payload outcomes.

findings.title: Upcoming removals have specific scope
findings.evidence: v29 Microsoft-page SOAP and data-only permissions; v30 Microsoft-page OData and PTE upload transition.
findings.recommendation: Add versioned migration table without claiming all SOAP/OData removed.
findings.resolution: Add versioned migration table without claiming all SOAP/OData removed.

findings.title: Inherent grant cannot be casually administered away
findings.evidence: Same-extension scope and code-defined permission/entitlement grant.
findings.recommendation: Add least-privilege design and output boundary.
findings.resolution: Add least-privilege design and output boundary.

findings.title: Tags require new-company and install handling
findings.evidence: Upgrade order between codeunits is not guaranteed.

findings.title: IsHandled is not a default override mechanism
findings.recommendation: Correct name and prefer intentional interfaces/additive events.
findings.resolution: Correct name and prefer intentional interfaces/additive events.

findings.title: Partial record can trigger extra loads
findings.evidence: Pass-by-value and unloaded-field access affect performance/consistency.
findings.recommendation: Add measured payload/JIT exercise and bounded claims.
findings.resolution: Add measured payload/JIT exercise and bounded claims.

findings.title: Online production cannot run automated tests
findings.evidence: Sandbox usage is restricted; containers suit large suites.

blog_intake.author: Stefano Demiliani
blog_intake.notes: Main failure explanation, illustrative snippets, stable recipient-enforced identity and delete discussion read. Accept failure exercise, not blanket rollback/retry/404 semantics. Snippets not compiled; original sequential local model explicitly limited.

blog_intake.author: Steven Renders
blog_intake.notes: Complete main March17,2026 article read. Accept contract-selection prompts only; reject overly broad SOAP/OData deprecation and guaranteed-replica implications, universal query-first and unmeasured performance rules. Comments/linked sources not exhaustively audited.

blog_intake.author: Richard Riley
blog_intake.notes: Complete main August25 transition announcement read in this sequential review context; September disclosures and planned November15 retirement, no automated feed ingestion.

offline_checks: 32 assertions for actual recipient block, duplicate/conflicting/cross-company identity, SQLite fanout/preaggregation, upgrade/payload/outcome and catalog calculations.

limitations: No AL compiler, tenant, container, app deployment, HTTP endpoint, paid-content, webinar or assessment execution.
Sequential in-memory recipient and SQLite join/calculation examples do not implement durable/concurrent idempotency or prove AL runtime behavior.
Long sources read in recorded sections; complete platform history, permission/localization/version matrices and linked procedures not exhaustively audited.
Sandbox read-intent exercise cannot establish replica routing/lag. Blog deprecation/replica generalizations and broad rollback language were not adopted.
OReilly direct access blocked; public indexed metadata separately recorded. Partner/community/practice shells unavailable and other commercial catalogs not comprehensively searched again.
Webinar recommendation withheld pending clarity about original question provenance; listing wording alone does not establish misuse.
Same-context AI review; independent human review and live lab validation remain pending.
